name: True Roman
source: True Roman is a dark historical western visual novel set in Ancient Rome, LXXXIV AD. You play as Centurion Lucius, leading your legion through the harsh forests of Germania after a disastrous ambush. There are multiple other characters set across the world of Ancient Rome each with their own stories and each story will be interwoven. The game features a branching narrative, dynamic choices, speech minigames, and dice-based skill checks. Your decisions shape relationships, morale, and the fate of your men. Includes both cinematic and longform storytelling modes. The demo covers the first dramatic episode of an episodic series inspired by classical literature and Roman history.
translation: 《真实罗马》是一部以公元七十四世纪古罗马为背景的黑暗历史西方视觉小说。你扮演百夫长卢修斯，在一次灾难性的伏击后带领你的军团穿过日耳曼尼亚的严酷森林。古罗马世界中还有多个其他角色，每个角色都有自己的故事，并且每个故事都会交织在一起。该游戏具有分支叙事、动态选择、语音小游戏和基于骰子的技能检查。你的决定决定着你手下的关系、士气和命运。包括电影和长篇故事讲述模式。该演示涵盖了受古典文学和罗马历史启发的剧集系列的第一集。
